test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: if a + (1)/(a) = 7sqrt3 , then what is the value of a⁶ + a⁻⁶?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k

Here, a + 1/a = 7√3

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = (7√3)³ − 3 × 7√3 = 1029√3 − 21√3 = 1008√3

Now apply the square formula (p² − 2) on the obtained result to get the 6th power:

⇒ a⁶ + a−⁶ = (1008√3)² − 2 = (1016064 × 3) − 2 = 3048192 − 2 = 3048190

**∴ The correct answer is 3048190.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a + 1/a = 7√3

**Formula Used:**

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

(x + y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3xy(x + y)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Squaring both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (a + 1/a)² = (7√3)²

⇒ a² + 1/a² + 2 × a × 1/a = 147

⇒ a² + 1/a² + 2 = 147

⇒ a² + 1/a² = 145

⇒ Cubing both sides of this new equation:

⇒ (a² + 1/a²)³ = 145³

⇒ (a²)³ + (1/a²)³ + 3 × a² × (1/a²) × (a² + 1/a²) = 3048625

⇒ a⁶ + 1/a⁶ + 3 × 1 × 145 = 3048625

⇒ a⁶ + a−⁶ + 435 = 3048625

⇒ a⁶ + a−⁶ = 3048625 − 435 = 3048190

**∴ The correct answer is 3048190.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Identity Trick

If x + 1/x = k, then the value of x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Cube Identity Trick

If x + 1/x = k, then the value of x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Fifth Power Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then the value of x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) − (x + 1/x).

Negative Power Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2 and x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.
